entry.title: Useful evidence begins with what a clock was trained to estimate—and the decision you need it to inform.
Interpret a change only after fixing the clock version, assay pipeline, score unit, repeatability and decision threshold.
The six-clock rentosertib analysis has a reported patient-label randomization check, but its selected 42-person cohort cannot establish aging-specific efficacy.
Keep the same base information, eligible participants, outcome and horizon when testing whether another aging clock adds value.
